content.short: Stanford Blockchain Club offers Stanford students the chance to learn about blockchain technology through events, workshops, and networking.
content.description: Stanford Blockchain Club helps Stanford University students learn about blockchain technology and its applications through a series of educational events, hands-on workshops, and networking opportunities. The group aims to spark innovation and support the growth of the blockchain ecosystem by enabling collaboration between students and industry professionals on blockchain research and development.
